🎉 ShieldClaw 1.0.0 - Initial Release!

  ✨ Core Features:
  - 🔍 Scan: Security scanning and risk assessment for OpenClaw Skills
  - 🛡️ Guard: Real-time behavior monitoring and threat interception
  - 📊 Audit: Operation logging and security reporting
  - 🔐 Vault: Sensitive data encryption and secure storage

  💰 Pricing:
  - Free: $0 forever, essential security features
  - Pro: $1.4/month, unlock advanced features
  - Team: $0.8-1.4/seat/month, best for teams

  🚀 Ready to protect your OpenClaw environment!
